Strategy rules

Strategy: Weekly Trend Rider

Enter long when price reclaims the EMA in an up regime

Direction: LONG

GIVEN no open position
WHEN price_crosses_above_ema(ema_period) AND sma_above_ema(sma_period, ema_period)
THEN enter LONG

Stop: entry_price * (1 - stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 + take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit long when price loses the EMA

Direction: LONG

GIVEN an open long position
WHEN price_crosses_below_ema(ema_period)
THEN close the position

Enter short when price breaks below the EMA

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN no open position
WHEN price_crosses_below_ema(ema_period)
THEN enter SHORT

Stop: entry_price * (1 + stop_loss_pct / 100)
Take: entry_price * (1 - take_profit_pct / 100)

Exit short when price reclaims the EMA

Direction: SHORT

GIVEN an open short position
WHEN price_crosses_above_ema(ema_period)
THEN close the position
